experiment.name: CARE-ECG next-generation validation-locked PTB-XL evaluation
experiment.scope: Official PTB-XL folds 1-8 for base training, fold 9 for validation and meta-model selection, and all 2,158 eligible prepared fold-10 records for the fixed-candidate evaluation

dataset.name: PTB-XL
dataset.label_projection: Highest-likelihood diagnostic superclass; ties follow NORM, MI, STTC, CD, HYP
dataset.cohort_definition: Records with at least one eligible diagnostic superclass after the declared highest-likelihood projection

normalization.policy: Global scalar mean and scale fitted on folds 1-8 only

causal_report_backbone.role_in_final_system: Latent biomarkers, Bayesian-component sensitivity, counterfactuals, causal RAG, and report generation; not the final diagnostic probability source

diagnosis_ensemble.method: Validation-locked regularized multinomial stack over log probabilities
source_order: official PTB-XL benchmark XResNet1D-101 exp0 adapter
legacy PTB-XL benchmark XResNet1D-50 checkpoint adapter
diagnosis_ensemble.validation_interpretation: Five-fold patient-grouped cross-fitting applies to the stacker only. These are hyperparameter-selection estimates over fixed base experts, not a fully nested independent estimate.
diagnosis_ensemble.reason: No added candidate improved the three-source patient-grouped OOF macro-F1

scp_meta_refit.feature_contract: 71 official XResNet101 SCP scores plus 25 fixed ontology aggregates
scp_meta_refit.distribution_shift_disclosure: The final refit adds fold-9 supervision under the standard stacked-learning refit convention. Reported validation metrics remain tied to the original folds1-8 model.

causal_knowledge.learned_model: Bayesian network over train-fitted quantile-discretized anonymous latent factors and diagnosis
causal_knowledge.diagnosis_aware_retrieval: Metadata-explicit competing superclass facts are excluded; matching class facts and generic evidence remain eligible
causal_knowledge.policy: Taxonomy is used for retrieval and provenance, not relabeled as physiological causation

locked_test_protocol.prior_test_disclosure: Aggregate fold-10 results from an earlier CARE-XResNet50 system were already known before this candidate was selected
locked_test_protocol.test_label_handling: The prediction CLI loads labels alongside signals for evaluation bookkeeping, but passes neither labels nor expected values into encode_batch_with_neural or run_encoded; expected is appended only after run_encoded returns

metric_comparability.classification: Five-superclass numeric comparison; the paper's exact label projection and free-text mapping protocol are unavailable
metric_comparability.crc: Not paper-comparable because the reported diagnosis posterior has zero causal-component weight and fused attribution availability is 0.0
metric_comparability.report_metrics: Repository-defined deterministic lexical proxies; the paper's evaluator prompts, code, and outputs are unavailable

external_provenance.xresnet101_scope: Legacy benchmark exp0 prediction source aligned by ECG ID; not a CARE-ECG paper artifact

artifacts.paper_pdf: /home/hao/ECG-care/CARE-ECG Causal Agent-based Reasoning for Explainable and Counterfactual ECG Interpretation__.pdf

reproduction_attestation.full_fixed_test_coverage_scope: All 2,158 eligible records in the prepared fold-10 diagnostic-superclass cohort; 40 of 2,198 raw fold-10 rows lack an eligible diagnostic superclass and are excluded by the declared cohort definition

workbook_summary.Interpretation: Numeric proximity alone does not establish reproduction.
workbook_summary.CRC comparability: NOT COMPARABLE: paper-exact metric implementation is not attested

selection_lock.scope: Model and decision policy selected from PTB-XL folds 1-9 only for the current candidate
selection_lock.selection_objective: Highest patient-grouped stacker OOF macro-F1 on fold 9; accuracy is the tie breaker; no post-selection class offsets

validation_selection.cross_fit_scope: Five patient-grouped folds for the linear stacker only
validation_selection.interpretation: Hyperparameter-selection estimate over fixed base experts; not an independent nested estimate of the complete system

final_inference_refit.disclosure: Standard post-selection base-model refit. Validation metrics remain tied to the folds1-8 model's out-of-sample fold9 probabilities; the refit changes the deployment probability distribution.

causal_and_report_backbone.architecture: InceptionTime supervised CausalVAE with encoder classifier
causal_and_report_backbone.role: Improved latent, Bayesian-component sensitivity, counterfactual, retrieval, and report backbone; final diagnosis comes from the locked external stack

candidate_audit.decision: Retain the three-source stack because every added candidate reduced patient-grouped OOF macro-F1

test_state_at_lock.disclosure: An earlier CARE-XResNet50 system had already been evaluated on fold 10, and label-free fold10 source arrays already existed. This lock establishes the current candidate settings before its new inference, not a globally untouched test set.

paper_comparability.official_xresnet101_source: Legacy PTB-XL benchmark exp0 predictions aligned by ECG ID; auxiliary replacement, not a CARE-ECG author artifact
paper_comparability.causal_attribution_scope: Bayesian-component latent-state sensitivity; it does not influence the weight-1 diagnosis posterior
paper_comparability.status_rule: Numerical target direction is reported separately from exact paper reproduction

experiment.name: CARE-ECG waveform-specialist model-improvement experiment
experiment.reason: The validation-eligible candidate reduced both macro recall and macro F1 on the sealed fold-10 evaluation

selection_protocol.feature_contract: 252 fixed waveform summaries plus age, sex, height, weight and four missingness indicators
selection_protocol.spectral_contract: Six normalized rFFT band powers with DC excluded from every numerator and the denominator
selection_protocol.eligibility: Strict improvement over the baseline in both macro recall and macro F1 on fold 9

validation_results.interpretation: A model-selection estimate, not an independent test estimate

paper_comparison.limitation: The paper's exact artifacts, label projection, free-text generator, and evaluation implementation are unavailable

decision.reason: No searched candidate improved the baseline patient-grouped OOF macro-F1; inferior models and prediction archives remain transient under /tmp and were not promoted into artifacts.
